examInfo.title: CTFL - V4.0 - EN - SAMPLE EXAM - MODEL A

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements describes a valid test objective?

options.label: a
options.text: To prove that there are no unfixed defects in the system under test.

options.label: b
options.text: To prove that there will be no failures after the implementation of the system into production.

options.label: c
options.text: To reduce the risk level of the test object and to build confidence in the quality level.

options.label: d
options.text: To verify that there are no untested combinations of inputs.

a.explanation: Testing cannot prove the absence of defects.

b.explanation: Testing cannot prove that there will be no failures in production.

c.explanation: Testing finds defects and failures, which reduces the level of risk and builds confidence in the quality level of the test object.

d.explanation: It is impossible to test all combinations of inputs.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a benefit of early and frequent stakeholder feedback?

options.label: a
options.text: It ensures that the system requirements are perfect before development begins.

options.label: b
options.text: It allows for early validation of requirements and helps to avoid misunderstandings.

options.label: c
options.text: It eliminates the need for testing during the development phase.

options.label: d
options.text: It guarantees that the project will be completed ahead of schedule.

b.explanation: Early feedback helps align expectations and catch issues early.

d.explanation: It doesn't guarantee schedule adherence, though it helps.
